turn1.explanation: The unit responds to two separate things: close-up cat faces (especially the eyes and nose region) and cars of many kinds.
turn1.evidence: Cat faces fill most of the top slots (#1, #2, #4–9), but a red Mercedes car is also at #3 with activation 9, and cars of many types (taxi, pickups, SUV, wagon) and views (front, side, rear) appear at 5–6. A 'face-like car front' link is ruled out by the rear and side views (#12, #17, #18), so the two concepts look unconnected.
turn1.missing_data: Activation over a full random sample, including dogs and other animal faces and other vehicles, to see whether both clusters hold up and whether anything links them.
